name: shader-caustics
title: Caustics
description: A web of refracted-light filaments, denser toward the bottom of the frame, drifts over a near-black floor, drawn in WebGL. An accent color can tint the filaments.
useWhen: Water, light, or premium ambient backdrops where refracted-light filaments fit the mood.
A calm, elegant scene wants motion without a strong directional pull.
You want the light density to build toward one edge of the frame (denser toward the bottom by default).
avoidWhen: You want structured cellular noise: use shader-voronoi.
You want soft fog instead of filaments: use shader-perlin-noise.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Two colors, comma separated: the floor, then the filament light.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Tint carried by the light or layers (see Accent amount).

variables.label: Accent amount
variables.description: How much of the accent shows, 0 to 1. The original animates it from the host timeline.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Spatial frequency of the light web.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
